claims.claim: A target positive occupation determines a unique state history field up to constants, f=log P_xx. This is a target-dependent inverse, not a provider.
On the frozen q12/N2 labelled reference, C1(f),C2(f)>0 for all g>0 while C1(E)=C2(E)=0. A single stationary mean-interaction entropy constraint cannot select the supplied Gibbs occupation.
At g=12/Lambda6, t=10^-16 gives an explicit positive same-mean occupation alternative with labelled history entropy advantage greater than 1/(2*10^18) nats per step.
